baseline.description: Immutable structural-conversion baseline. Source and destination hashes remain in docs/imports/*.json.

policy.hash_rule: An edited derivative must record its current SHA-256 and at least one revision ID; matching the baseline does not require a revision.
policy.rights_rule: Editorial revision and distribution state do not establish material-specific reuse permission.

revisions.summary: Canonicalized eleven semantically overlapping bibliography groups, corrected three erroneous published records, and rewired affected chapter citations without changing scientific claims.
revisions.evidence: docs/bibliography-map.json; DOI/title/author/version comparisons recorded by the Phase 1 audit
revisions.validation: Fast validation, BibTeX resolution, and chapter-tier build required before merge.

revisions.summary: Converted Chapter 2 from article order to a software-centered dissertation argument; moved package architecture before implementation details, stated the 1.1.0/1.1.1/1.1.2 provenance boundary, removed stale article navigation, and implemented all display dispositions while preserving negative held-out evidence.
revisions.evidence: docs/editorial-issues.json; docs/display-ledger.json; fixed exdqlm article and package snapshots recorded in source-manifest.json
revisions.validation: Fast and chapter milestone validation, rendered-page inspection, and final log review required before merge.
